title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Bank of Baroda for Fair Practices Code violations
description: <cite index="84-1,84-2,84-3">RBI imposed a total penalty of Rs. 66.7 lakh on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance for violations related to regulatory compliance.</cite> <cite index="84-4,84-5">Bank of Baroda has been fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with provisions of the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.</cite> <cite index="84-7">The regulator found that the public sector lender had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts.</cite>
